scope: Farmer and agriculture-related Central and State/UT schemes and official government portals.
note: Curated agriculture-focused dataset. It is not a complete mirror of every scheme on myScheme. Farmers should verify current eligibility, availability and application deadlines on the official portal before applying.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.benefits: Financial support subject to current scheme rules and exclusions.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families; exclusions and conditions apply.
schemes.application_process: Register or complete required farmer details through official PM-KISAN services.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial protection against specified crop losses.
schemes.benefits: Insurance coverage for notified crops and risks according to scheme and state notifications.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified crops in notified areas, subject to applicable rules.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the official PMFBY portal or notified channels within the applicable season deadline.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Provides timely agricultural credit for cultivation and eligible allied activities.
schemes.benefits: Access to agricultural credit through participating banks under applicable KCC terms.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and eligible agricultural/allied activity borrowers as determined by the lending institution.
schemes.application_process: Approach a participating bank or its official digital application channel.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM
schemes.description: Supports deployment of solar energy systems for agriculture, including eligible solar pumps.
schemes.benefits: Financial support under applicable PM-KUSUM components.
schemes.eligibility: Varies by component, state implementation and applicant category.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the state implementing agency or official state portal notified for PM-KUSUM.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
schemes.description: Supports irrigation development and efficient water use in agriculture.
schemes.benefits: Support under applicable irrigation and water-use components.
schemes.eligibility: Depends on the relevant PMKSY component and implementing authority.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the concerned state or implementing department.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides soil testing and nutrient-management information.
schemes.benefits: Soil nutrient information and fertilizer recommendations based on soil tests.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers can use soil-testing services provided through the government system.
schemes.application_process: Use the official Soil Health Card portal or designated soil-testing facility.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.description: Promotes organic farming through cluster-based approaches and assistance.
schemes.benefits: Support for eligible organic farming activities under applicable guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Varies by implementation component and farmer/group participation.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the designated state agriculture department or implementing agency.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
schemes.description: Supports state-led agricultural development projects and interventions.
schemes.benefits: Benefits depend on projects and components implemented by states.
schemes.eligibility: Depends on the specific state-level component or project.
schemes.application_process: Follow the application process announced by the implementing state department.

schemes.name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
schemes.description: Supports improvement of production and productivity of selected food crops.
schemes.benefits: Input, technology and productivity support under applicable components.
schemes.eligibility: Depends on crop, area and component notified by the implementing authority.
schemes.application_process: Contact the state agriculture department or designated implementing office.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.description: Promotes access to agricultural machinery and mechanization support.
schemes.benefits: Assistance for eligible farm machinery and mechanization activities under state implementation.
schemes.eligibility: Varies by machinery, farmer category and state implementation.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the concerned state agriculture department or designated portal.

schemes.name: Agriculture Technology Management Agency (ATMA)
schemes.description: Supports agricultural extension, training, demonstrations and farmer capacity building.
schemes.benefits: Training, demonstrations, exposure and extension support through local programmes.
schemes.eligibility: Depends on local ATMA programmes and participating farmer groups.
schemes.application_process: Contact the district ATMA/agriculture office for current programmes.

schemes.name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
schemes.description: Promotes sustainable agricultural practices, resource conservation and climate-resilient farming.
schemes.benefits: Support under applicable sustainable agriculture components.
schemes.eligibility: Depends on the component and state implementation.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the concerned agriculture department or implementing agency.

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.description: Supports holistic development of horticulture including production and post-harvest activities.
schemes.benefits: Assistance for eligible horticulture activities and infrastructure.
schemes.eligibility: Depends on crop, activity, farmer category and state guidelines.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the state horticulture department or designated agency.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
schemes.description: Supports sustainable development of fisheries and aquaculture activities.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance under eligible fisheries and aquaculture components.
schemes.eligibility: Varies by component and state fisheries implementation.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the state fisheries department or designated portal.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.description: Financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
schemes.benefits: Interest-related financial support and credit facilitation for eligible projects.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, SHGs, agri-entrepreneurs and other notified beneficiaries.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the official AIF or participating financial institution channel.

schemes.name: Rythu Bharosa
schemes.description: Telangana farmer investment support programme.
schemes.benefits: Agricultural investment support according to current state programme rules.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers meeting the current Telangana programme conditions.
schemes.application_process: Use official Telangana agriculture/farmer service channels.

schemes.name: YSR Rythu Bharosa
schemes.description: Agricultural farmer support programme of Andhra Pradesh.
schemes.benefits: Benefits depend on current state programme and beneficiary categories.
schemes.eligibility: As specified by the Andhra Pradesh government for the current programme.
schemes.application_process: Use official Andhra Pradesh agriculture/farmer service channels.

schemes.name: MahaDBT Farmer Schemes
schemes.description: Maharashtra farmer portal for agriculture scheme components and subsidies.
schemes.benefits: Access to multiple state agriculture scheme components and subsidies.
schemes.eligibility: Varies by individual scheme component.
schemes.application_process: Register/login through the official MahaDBT Farmer portal and select the relevant scheme.

schemes.name: i-Khedut Agriculture Schemes
schemes.description: Gujarat platform for farmer assistance programmes and agricultural schemes.
schemes.benefits: Benefits vary by selected agricultural scheme.
schemes.eligibility: Varies by scheme; state residency, land and activity conditions may apply.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the official i-Khedut portal under Agricultural Schemes.

schemes.name: Assistance for Use of Soil Conditioner
schemes.description: Assistance for soil conditioners to address pH and nutrient deficiencies based on soil testing.
schemes.benefits: Subsidy for eligible soil conditioners under the state agriculture programme.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers carrying out agricultural activities in Goa and meeting current programme conditions.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the concerned Zonal Agriculture Officer.

schemes.name: Production of Foundation Seeds
schemes.description: Supports farmers involved in production of foundation seeds, particularly pulses.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for eligible foundation seed production.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers residing in Tamil Nadu who raise seed farms with eligible pulse crops.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the concerned agricultural office.

schemes.name: Plant Protection including Integrated Pest Management Scheme
schemes.description: Supports plant health management through bio-pesticides, IPM tools and plant-protection equipment.
schemes.benefits: Free or subsidized eligible IPM tools and plant-protection equipment under the scheme.
schemes.eligibility: Bonafide farmers engaged in agriculture and meeting Meghalaya programme conditions.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the nearest agriculture development office.

schemes.name: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
schemes.description: Livestock insurance support for eligible livestock owners in Haryana.
schemes.benefits: Financial protection against covered livestock loss due to animal death.
schemes.eligibility: Livestock owners meeting Haryana programme requirements.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the official Haryana service portal.

schemes.name: Krishak Bandhu
schemes.description: West Bengal farmer support programme.
schemes.benefits: Farmer support benefits according to current Krishak Bandhu programme rules.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers meeting current West Bengal programme conditions.
schemes.application_process: Use official West Bengal agriculture/farmer service channels.

schemes.name: KALIA
schemes.description: Odisha farmer and agricultural support programme.
schemes.benefits: Benefits depend on current state programme and beneficiary category.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers meeting current Odisha programme conditions.
schemes.application_process: Use official Odisha agriculture/KALIA service channels.

schemes.eligibility: Varies by individual scheme.
schemes.application_process: Use the official Raj Kisan Sathi portal and select the applicable service/scheme.
